findings.affected_surface: PLAN §3 co-signal rule, PLAN §2 KR3, PLAN §4 P4 foreman round-end and dogfood
findings.claim: The G1 co-signal fold is contradicted by P4/KR3, which still treat an S4-only zero-hit seed as a U2 climb and describe the foreman round-end as climbing U1-U2 whenever budget remains.
findings.evidence: Section 3 co-signal rule: S4 alone recommends at most U1; U2 needs S4 plus one of S1/S2/S3/S5, or S4 with --fast-moving. P4 acceptance: one /l4 run on a seeded unknown whose key terms have zero knowledge hits shows a U2 ladder row inside a foreman round. That seed is S4-only. P4 round-end text runs classify, then U1-U2 within CEO DOA when budget left, without only when recommend is U1 or U2. KR3 is verified by the same U2 dogfood. Together this reopens the R10 every-new-noun survey path at the KR3 site.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §3 Co-signal rule (R10); PLAN §2 KR3; PLAN §4 P4 level-front-door round-end sequence and KR3 dogfood acceptance; FROZEN_RUBRIC R10
findings.repair: P4/KR3 dogfood must seed S4 plus a second signal or an explicit --fast-moving cue, not zero-hit terms alone. Round-end acts only on classify.recommend; the DOA table lists which rungs are allowed, not a climb-if-budget-left rule. P1 and P4 tests: S4-only inside a foreman round is U0 or U1, never U2.

findings.affected_surface: PLAN §3 heterogeneity rule, PLAN §4 P3 L-2, PLAN §3 files table skills/dev-flow/SKILL.md, skills/dev-flow/references/hetero-loops.md Consult before design
findings.claim: The C5 skip is specified on the probe, but the primary U1 call site is still an unconditional consult-before-design dispatch, so native-fallback consult still runs.
findings.evidence: Section 3 heterogeneity rule: before any U1 spawn, consult_resolved_from native-fallback or consult_dispatch off means recommend U2, skipped_rungs [U1], and dispatch-consult.sh is never invoked. P3 L-2 adds consult before design (receipted) replacing the reference-only rule, with no classify gate and no skipped-U1 path. The files table says L-2 gains the consult-before-design step with receipt (C3). Live hetero-loops.md Consult before design already tells every L-size task to call dispatch-consult.sh with --question-file and --artifact before the L-2 design decision. That U1 spawn does not read consult_resolved_from, so C5/R12 never fire on the common consult.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §3 Heterogeneity rule (R12); PLAN §4 P3 skills/dev-flow/SKILL.md L-2; PLAN §3 Files skills/dev-flow/SKILL.md row; skills/dev-flow/references/hetero-loops.md Consult before design; FROZEN_RUBRIC R12
findings.repair: L-2 is a ladder U1 spawn: run classify with the site argv, then call dispatch-consult.sh only on recommend U1. If the probe skipped U1 (not-heterogeneous or consult_dispatch off), L-2 must not invoke dispatch-consult.sh; follow recommend (U2 survey when that is the skip, else none). Same gate as debug step 4.

findings.affected_surface: PLAN §4 P2 receipt-on-dispatch, PLAN §4 P3 debug/think-tank/L-2, PLAN §4 P4 dogfood, PLAN §3 files hetero-dispatch.md four call sites
findings.claim: Canonical sites still do not all run classify with a fully spelled argv and persist a kind ladder row on U2/U3 dispatch, so KR1 cannot observe those climbs and the probe-wired-but-never-called failure remains.
findings.evidence: P2 receipt-on-dispatch exists only as dispatch-consult.sh --ladder-receipt after a successful U1 emit. P3 debug on U2 runs survey issue-search and on U3 dispatches the debugger PUA, with no receipt command. P3 think-tank appends kind unknown on LOW consensus and leaves the dialectic U3 climb unchanged: no classify, no kind ladder row, no budget or knob check. P3 L-2 has no classify argv. P3 acceptance claims each inline SKILL spells full argv (--ledger, --terms where present), but debug uses an ellipsis --ledger … and think-tank has no classify line. P4 dogfood requires a U2 ladder row inside a foreman round, yet P4 never calls receipt after survey. KR1 is measured from receipts with signal not judgment-only; U2/U3 autonomous climbs have no writer.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §4 P2 dispatch-consult.sh --ladder-receipt; PLAN §4 P3 debug step 4, think-tank, acceptance; PLAN §4 P4 KR3 dogfood; PLAN §3 Files references/hetero-dispatch.md Hook points; PLAN §2 KR1; FROZEN_RUBRIC R9
findings.repair: Each of the four sites spells a full classify argv in the SKILL or front-door line. Every U1/U2/U3 dispatch appends kind ladder: U1 via --ladder-receipt, U2/U3 via probe-unknown.js receipt with signal_ids after the existing rail returns. Think-tank runs classify and climbs U3 only on recommend U3 with budget left. P3/P4 acceptance greps those argv strings and requires one U2 row produced by the survey path, not by a hand-edited fixture.

findings.affected_surface: PLAN §0.5 C7, PLAN §3 ladder row shape, PLAN §4 P1 receipt --resolved, PLAN §4 P5 finish-flow learn
findings.claim: P5 makes learn mandatory on resolved true at rung >= 1, but no phase names a writer for that field, so the close-the-loop never fires.
findings.evidence: C7 still keys learn on resolved_at_rung >= 1. The §3 ladder shape is resolved: bool, and P1 receipt has optional --resolved. P3, P4, and P6 never say which call site passes --resolved, after which rail return, or with which test. P5: if probe-unknown.js report shows any resolved true row at rung >= 1, autopilot:learn is mandatory. Unset bools stay false, so L-5.6 remains if warranted. KR4 can count climbs, but the next S4 lookup still misses because learn is not actually forced. That is the R14 nothing-is-written-back failure.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §0.5 C7; PLAN §3 Files decision-ledger.js ladder shape; PLAN §4 P1 receipt [--resolved]; PLAN §4 P5; FROZEN_RUBRIC R14
findings.repair: Pick one writer and use it in P5. Preferred: receipt-on-dispatch for rung >= 1 (except reason knob-off, budget-exhausted, or not-heterogeneous) is the learn trigger, and finish-flow does not require a second --resolved attestation; align C7 to that. Alternative: name the site, argv, and fixture that set resolved true after the caller uses the rail result. P5 acceptance must use a row from that writer, not a hand-edited resolved true.

findings.affected_surface: PLAN §3 exhaustion rule, PLAN §4 P1 budget-exhausted fixture, PLAN §4 P2 exhaustion, PLAN §4 P4 U4 [ESCALATION]
findings.claim: Budget exhaustion may recommend U4, and P4 maps U4 to [ESCALATION], so spending a budget can halt a foreman run.
findings.evidence: Section 3 exhaustion rule: a spent rung emits reason budget-exhausted and the recommendation becomes none or U4, never a more expensive rung. P2 repeats none or U4. P1 tests: budget exhausted implies none/U4 never higher. P4: U4 implies [ESCALATION] with ladder_receipts. C8 cites level-front-door: the run stops at DOA, irreversible, or input, and [ESCALATION] is that stop. KR5/R11: the ladder never blocks, no hook Stop, no non-zero halt, remind-only, --strict opt-in only. Turning a spent integer budget into owner escalation is a phase halt in the name of the ladder, not a signal that the owner must see.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §3 Exhaustion rule (R13); PLAN §4 P1 budget exhausted fixture; PLAN §4 P2 Exhaustion; PLAN §4 P4 U4 [ESCALATION]; PLAN §0.5 C8; PLAN §2 KR5; FROZEN_RUBRIC R11
findings.repair: Exhaustion always recommend none with reason budget-exhausted; the Ladder section prints used/left. Never recommend U4 from exhaustion. U4 is only when signals say the owner must see an unresolved unknown. P1 fixture: exhausted => none, not U4. P4 [ESCALATION] only when recommend is U4.

findings.affected_surface: PLAN §0.5 C2 resolution, PLAN §3 files table skills/ceo-agent/SKILL.md step 7, PLAN §4 P0 survey Boundary, PLAN §4 P4 step 7
findings.claim: The G1 R8 fold fixed P0, but C2 and the ceo-agent step 7 line still teach judgment-only auto survey, which is the pre-ruling participatory split.
findings.evidence: P0 now: a survey runs without a Proceed prompt only when the probe recommends U2 with budget left, in every mode; judgment-only, knob-off, and budget-exhausted keep the confirm template. Q1/C6 match that. Section 0.5 C2 resolution still says reword to no auto-trigger in participatory modes, and in just-results the caller may invoke without confirmation. Files table ceo-agent step 7 becomes probe says U2 or judgment (recorded). P4 step 7 is reworded to cite the probe but does not retract the judgment disjunct. An implementer of C2 or P4 can reintroduce autonomous judgment-only survey in just-results, which P0 forbids.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §0.5 C2; PLAN §0.5 C6; PLAN §3 Files skills/ceo-agent/SKILL.md; PLAN §4 P0 survey Boundary; PLAN §4 P4 step 7; PLAN §8 Q1; FROZEN_RUBRIC R8
findings.repair: Rewrite the C2 resolution to match P0/Q1 (probe-recommended U2 with budget, every mode; judgment-only keeps confirm and is not an autonomous dispatch). CEO step 7: invoke survey only when recommend is U2 with budget left; record judgment-only suggestions without dispatching.

findings.affected_surface: PLAN §4 P1 probe-unknown.js receipt, scripts/decision-ledger.js append stdout
findings.claim: receipt shells out to decision-ledger.js append, which already prints one JSON object on stdout, so receipt can emit two objects and fail the one-JSON contract.
findings.evidence: decision-ledger.js append writes JSON.stringify(full) to stdout after taking the lock. P1 receipt runs decision-ledger.js append and never writes the file itself, but does not say to capture or suppress child stdout. R2 and §2.5: new scripts emit one JSON object on stdout and human lines on stderr. classify is specified that way; receipt is not. A naive spawn of append plus a second print yields two JSON objects on the first receipt test.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN §2.5 Global Constraints; PLAN §4 P1 receipt; scripts/decision-ledger.js append() stdout write; FROZEN_RUBRIC R2
findings.repair: receipt captures append stdout and prints exactly one JSON object (the appended ladder row or a wrapper). Do not forward child stdout. classify, receipt, and report each emit one object; diagnostics stay on stderr.
